context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 new features tested and working: 1) POS Manual Price Override - editable price Input with data-testid='edit-price-{product_id}' on cart items, changes recalculate subtotal. 2) Partner Order Unit Selection - per-item unit selector with data-testid='cart-unit-{idx}', options Dus/Satuan, changing unit changes price accordingly. Selling satuan from dus warehouse deducts fractional stock (qty/items_per_box). 3) Return/Retur Feature - 'Retur' button on order rows opens dialog with qty/reason/warehouse inputs, POST /api/returns creates return, restores stock, reduces partner debt, sets has_return=true. RETUR badge shows on orders with returns. Fixed has_return field missing in PartnerOrder response model.
